text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT opened (sev=2) — multiple container restarts observed in prod-serving-ns. Trigger: gpu-prefill OOMs causing v2 shards to restart. PagerDuty: PD#98765. Affected: 3 pods on node g4-12-prod-03.

sanjay: seeing spike in 5xxs from serving gateway, yep. linking metrics: https://grafana.redwood/alerts/98765

mira: logs show repeated CUDA OOM during prefill on model 'redwood-12b-ctx' when clients send ~100k token contexts. exact error:

mira: ```
RuntimeError: CUDA out of memory. Tried to allocate 3.00 GiB (GPU 0; 16.00 GiB total capacity; 13.14 GiB already allocated; 2.86 GiB free; 13.50 GiB reserved in total by PyTorch)
Stacktrace: ... serving_runtime::prefill.cpp:line 412
```

benn: (cc @mira) can we confirm this is prefill not decode?

mira: confirmed. prefill path. large context windows + long prompt sets from one customer session.

alice: we've had 3 container restarts in the last 8 minutes on that node. kube events: 

alice: ```
Normal  Killing    pod/v2-serving-89df   Stopping container with id docker://serving: Container killed due to OOM
Warning BackOff     pod/v2-serving-89df   Back-off restarting failed container
```

sanjay: immediate mitigation options?

mira: short term: 1) route heavy-context traffic to fallback lower-capacity model (redwood-6b-ctx) 2) set runtime max_prefill_tokens=8192 for that model pool 3) cordon and drain node if underlying GPU behaving flaky

infra-bot: Suggested action: `kubectl scale --replicas=0 deployment/v2-serving` for the affected pool to stop new sessions while we triage.

alice: I'm going to temporarily remove node from rotation. `kubectl cordon g4-12-prod-03` then `kubectl drain g4-12-prod-03 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

mira: also pushing a runtime hotpatch to enforce a soft prefill token cap (reject > 65k tokens) on gateway level. patch: `gateway.config.max_prefill_tokens=65536`

sanjay: applying gateway patch now. will patch routing rules to send model variant redwood-6b-ctx for sessions flagged as large_context.

support-bot: Customer-impact: 1 enterprise customer (acct: AtlasHealth) reported degraded responses; retries causing timeouts. CS notified and preparing status update.

ben: rolling restart avoided for now — after cordon/drain, pods rescheduled to g4-12-prod-07 and g4-12-prod-09. watching for repeat OOMs.

mira: quick note — logs show prefill KV cache grew unusually large before OOM. suspect large system prompts with many embedded documents + conversation history. We'll throttle cache growth to avoid sudden peak.

sanjay: has anybody seen CUDA driver errors?

alice: no driver resets in dmesg, just memory oom. But one container had a brief `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` before restart, might be a red herring.

mira: mitigation checklist: 
- gateway soft cap deployed (done)
- route large_context -> redwood-6b-ctx (in progress)
- cordon/drain node g4-12-prod-03 (done)
- increase prefill-gc frequency in runtime (planned)

ben: I'm kicking off a controlled restart of the affected deployment with `--max-unavailable=0` to avoid rolling too many at once.

support-bot: CS status: sent intermediate update to AtlasHealth — they report partial success with retries but still higher latency.

mira: can ops oncall monitor GPU memory trends for the other nodes? query: `sum(nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes - nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes) by (instance)`

oncall-bot: @oncall-person paged via PagerDuty PD#98765 — you're the current oncall for infra.

oncall-person (sanjay): I'm on it. watching logs and traces. set alert to 90% GPU mem usage.

alice: after routing change we saw decrease in OOM events. current error rate down from 6% -> 0.8% for v2 pool.

mira: next actions: create incident ticket, collect core logs, heap dump for the restarted containers, gather sample client payloads that triggered the prefill.

sanjay: assigning postmortem owner: @mira. ETA for initial postmortem draft: EOD today.

ben: long term mitigation ideas to capture in postmortem: per-session prefill limits, adaptive token spilling to host memory, safer quantization profiles during prefill, and improved SLO for fallback routing.

alice: tagging this as P2, but if AtlasHealth is heavily affected we may escalate. CS will update if severity needs bump.

support-bot: CS confirms AtlasHealth saw ~12% request failures over 10m window starting 2024-11-05T21:12Z. They're asking for root cause and ETA.

mira: temporary workaround note for support: recommend clients trim context or request chunked embeddings for very long docs. sending suggested message template to CS.

incident-bot: Incident updated — mitigations applied, decreased error rate. Will keep thread open for follow-up and postmortem.

sanjay: thanks all. handing off to next oncall for overnight watch: @mira you take the rotation?

mira: taking overnight watch. I'll add a runbook step to detect prefill spikes and automatically reroute large sessions to lower-memory models.

alice: adding a follow-up ticket to infra backlog for host-memory spill prototype — INFRA-2043.

ben: thumbs up. we'll include perf regression tests to avoid future surprises. :thumbsup:

support-bot: Closing customer update loop: AtlasHealth informed of mitigations and expected timeline for postmortem.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: INCIDENT marked as mitigated — monitoring.

mira: leaving notes for postmortem: sample payloads stored in s3://incidents/3141592653/samples, logs in /var/log/serving/3141592653.tar.gz, will attach to ticket.

sanjay: good job team.
